headline: The machine slept from 6:31 PM to 7:17 AM — third outage in six days, five morning routines missed — while today holds two live appointments: the 11:00 appraisal on the $899K file and the FIRST-EVER showing on the $1.15M listing at 12:30 · DO: text Nicole W. — the money cleared, send the addendum · WATCH: 683 Flag Cir is past its contract date with nothing papered.

notes: 🔴 THE APP WENT DARK 6:31 PM TUESDAY AND CAME BACK AT 7:17 THIS MORNING — THE THIRD OUTAGE IN SIX DAYS. Nothing failed; nothing was awake. Missed in that window: the nightly Deep Dive (so Tuesday never got graded), inbox triage, the Money Pulse, the database routine's MY DAILY 10, and the marketing engine's morning queue. The Daily itself landed 80 minutes late at 7:25 AM and only because its session happened to survive the gap. Zero BLOCKED lines in 24 hours — which is exactly the blind spot: a routine that never started can't report a failure.

⚠️ THE FIX FOR THIS IS ALREADY WRITTEN DOWN AND STILL UNBUILT AT WEEK TWO. Catch-up-on-reopen — missed critical runs fire once, in order, the moment the app returns — has been the p1 build since 7/19 and is the first item on the build list below. This morning's letter pitched it again with a one-tap approval. The 7/25 version of this same hole is what let a written offer with a Sunday-7PM fuse land inside a dark window.

✅ THE BOARDS THEMSELVES ARE CURRENT AND QUIET. Nothing has arrived from ShowingTime since 5:27 PM yesterday, so no new buyer signal went unread overnight and no alert was missed. Both consoles were rebuilt from live sources this morning rather than carried forward, and the showing board's alert ledger needed no new entries.
